explanation: Multiple bugs were present: (1) The slice `xs[max(0,i-window):i]` used `i` as the exclusive end, so it excluded the current element at index `i`. It should be `xs[max(0, i-window+1):i+1]` to include the current position. (2) The divisor was always `window` instead of the actual number of elements in the window slice, causing wrong results when fewer than `window` elements are available (e.g., at the start). It should divide by `len(window_vals)`. (3) There was no validation that `1 <= min_periods <= window`. (4) There was no null (None) return for positions where the count of available values is less than `min_periods`.
